                    ### Question

                    ### Options
                    opa. Decreased serum 2,3-bisphosphoglycerate concentration
opb. Increased serum pH
opc. Increased hemoglobin γ-chain synthesis
opd. Increased body temperature
ope. Decreased serum pCO2

This change is supported by the fact that decreased 2,3-BPG concentration enhances hemoglobin's affinity for oxygen, causing the shift observed in the graphs.
